verdict.rationale: OpenClaw is self-hosted on the user's own machine. Its memory is plain Markdown files in a local workspace (the model only remembers what is saved to disk), and session history is per-agent local SQLite, so the user physically owns and can delete their data. Chat links are also revocable. However, no documented retention policies, deletion commands, or purge controls appear in the evidence; missing for 10: explicit retention-period configuration, documented session/memory deletion or purge commands, guidance on data held by third-party LLM providers and channels, independent or hands-on corroboration.
